why.quote: Vidya Hospital & Kidney Centre, owned by Dr. Shubha Dubey, is a 50-bed renal care facility located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh. Established in 1988, it specializes in nephrology and offers 24-hour dialysis services with 10 units and intensive renal care facilities.
What we do includes Internal Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Surgery (Laparoscopic), Orthopaedics, Dental & Maxillofacial, Intensive Care Unit, Nephrology, Dialysis & Urology, and Neurosurgery.
Dialysis treatment is provided using 25 dialysis machines.

MMI Narayana Multispeciality Hospital, Raipur is a unit of Narayana Health which is the largest Cardiology and Cardiac Surgery programme in Chhatisgarh. It also has the largest dialysis centre in Central India. It is a general hospital and offers services in specialities like Plastic Surgery, Adult and Paediatric Cardiology and Cardiac Surgery, Nephrology, Urology, Neurology and Neurosurgery, Dermatology, Dental Sciences as well as various eye care services etc. On top of it all, a team of specialists trained in Emergency and trauma make it one of the best eye care as well as a general hospital in the state of Chhatisgarh.
